draws.name: Elk and moose lottery (once in a lifetime)
draws.quote: Elk, moose and bighorn sheep applications are available online at the North Dakota Game and Fish Department's website, gf.nd.gov. The application deadline is March 25.

draws.name: Bighorn sheep lottery (apply with elk/moose; drawing held after Sept 1 surveys; max 1 nonresident license)
draws.quote: Applications for the annual bighorn sheep lottery are due at the same time as elk and moose (usually late March), however the lottery itself is not run until September 1

draws.name: Nonresident any-deer archery lottery
draws.quote: Nonresident Any Deer Archery online lottery applications are available between April 15 and May 15 each year.

draws.name: Deer gun, youth and muzzleloader lottery (first lottery; nonresidents draw from a separate ~1% pool)
draws.quote: Applicants for regular deer gun, gratis, youth and muzzleloader can apply online through the Game and Fish Department's website at gf.nd.gov. The deadline for applying is midnight June 3.

draws.name: Pronghorn lottery
draws.quote: Only North Dakota residents are eligible to apply for a pronghorn license. … Hunters can apply online . The application deadline is Aug. 5.

pointOnly.name: Resident bonus point purchase instead of a license (deer gun, muzzleloader, pronghorn) — checked on the lottery application
pointOnly.quote: As per state law resident hunters, who do not want to receive a hunting license issued by lottery, may purchase one bonus point for a fee that is the same as the respective license.

fees.label: Resident deer gun license (1st lottery), age 16+
fees.notes: Ages 15 and under $10. Deer bow (16+) is also $35. Fee table is undated; recorded as the current posted schedule.

fees.label: Resident bonus point purchase (same as license fee; e.g. deer gun or pronghorn 16+)
fees.notes: Amount = the respective license fee per state law (FAQ); $35 is the posted 16+ deer gun and pronghorn license fee.
fees.quote: may purchase one bonus point for a fee that is the same as the respective license

fees.label: Resident elk license, age 16+
fees.notes: Moose and bighorn sheep (resident, 16+) are also $35; ages 15 and under $10.

fees.label: Resident elk / moose / bighorn sheep nonrefundable application fee
fees.notes: Sheep application fee is not refunded even if no sheep season is held (news 9083).
fees.quote: Nonrefundable Application Fee … Elk (age 16 or older) | $35 | $2 | $20 | $5

fees.label: Nonresident deer gun license (1st lottery), includes $5 nonrefundable application fee
fees.notes: After the second lottery a nonresident deer gun license is $55 if available. White-tailed deer bow (nonresident) is $350.
fees.quote: Deer Gun (1st Lottery) - Includes a $5 nonrefundable application fee. After second lottery is held, a nonresident deer gun license is $55, if available. | $355

fees.label: Nonresident bighorn sheep nonrefundable application fee
fees.notes: Listed price $600 = $100 application fee + $500 license if drawn.
fees.quote: Bighorn Sheep - Includes $100 nonrefundable application fee. Successful applicants must pay an additional $500 for the license. | $600

fees.label: Nonresident bighorn sheep license (if drawn)
fees.quote: Successful applicants must pay an additional $500 for the license.

fees.label: General Game and Habitat License (one per year; required for all hunting licenses)
fees.notes: Residents may buy a $62 combination license instead.
fees.quote: General Game and Habitat License: Required for all hunting licenses except furbearer. Need only purchase one per year per licensee.

fees.label: Fishing, Hunting, Furbearer Certificate — resident
fees.quote: Fishing, Hunting, Furbearer Certificate: Required to hunt or fish in North Dakota. Need only purchase one per year per licensee.

prerequisites.text: Hunter education certificate (or apprentice license) if born after 1961.
prerequisites.quote: If you were born after 1961, to hunt in North Dakota you must have a: hunter education certificate or apprentice hunting license

prerequisites.text: Moose, elk and pronghorn lotteries are for North Dakota residents only.
prerequisites.quote: Moose, elk, pronghorn, spring turkey, and the first fall turkey lottery are all open only to North Dakota residents .

prerequisites.text: Elk, moose and bighorn sheep lottery licenses are once in a lifetime; once drawn you cannot apply for that species again.
prerequisites.quote: Elk, moose and bighorn sheep lottery licenses are issued as once-in-a-lifetime licenses in North Dakota.

prerequisites.text: Each license also needs the Fishing, Hunting, Furbearer Certificate and the General Game and Habitat License (bought once per year).
prerequisites.quote: General Game and Habitat License: Required for all hunting licenses except furbearer, nongame, spring light goose and early Canada goose.

prerequisites.text: Pronghorn applicants must be at least 12 by Dec. 31.
prerequisites.quote: Applicants must be at least 12 on or before Dec. 31.

notes: 2027 dates are not posted (species pages still show 2026 deadlines; the 'Approximate Lottery Annual Schedule' gives only month ranges: moose/elk/sheep early March–late March, results mid-April; deer early May–early June, results late June; pronghorn mid-July–early August, results mid-August). 'opens' dates are the dates of the NDGF news releases announcing applications were online (Mar 4, May 8, Jul 23, 2026), not formally posted opening dates. Deadline time: NDGF says 'Applications must be in by midnight on the day of the deadline' but names no time zone, so time and timezone are left out. resultsBy 2026-06-24 for deer = date of the 'Deer Lottery Held, Licenses Remain' release; other result dates were not posted. Bighorn sheep: nonresidents may apply but by law no more than one license goes to a nonresident; sheep drawing waits for Sept 1 surveys. Resident deer gun has no separate application fee in the table. Fee tables are undated; recorded as the current posted schedule with year 2026. Point-only purchase window = the lottery application itself (no separate dates). All gf.nd.gov pages loaded with curl; nothing was blocked.
